How to play

Create an account with your name and a four-digit PIN, then sign in. Enter the game code from your host and choose a callsign.

Your group

Keep your assigned role private. Complete physical missions with your group and follow your NCO's instructions.

Round table

Vote for another active player in your group. You can change your vote until voting closes. The host can select among tied candidates or publish no banishment.

Night

Active Traitors choose a Faithful target. The host checks physical objectives, confirms one outcome per group for that night and publishes it. If choices differ, the host decides which proposed target to confirm.

Eliminated players

Keep helping with physical missions. You cannot vote or take further private Traitor actions.

Hosting

An approved host can create a game, share its code, assign roles, change stages, score missions and publish outcomes. Roles cannot be reassigned. Ending a game reveals all roles and declares group winners.
